hold_reasoning: No order clears the bar today. The only new high-conviction note is yolo-sapiens-usd's 8/10 Nasdaq breakdown call through QQQS.L. QQQS.L is a 3x short, so it is a hedge and must be sized at 1/3 of the Nasdaq exposure it offsets. My only Nasdaq exposure is NVDA at about EUR 188, so a correctly sized hedge is about EUR 63. That is far below the EUR 250 minimum, and rounding it up would over-hedge, so I am not placing it. Separately, cash is EUR 391.93 against the EUR 150 floor, which leaves about EUR 242 to deploy. That is below the EUR 250 band, so no new entry fits the risk budget in any case. The book already has 6 real positions plus 0.15 EUR of SLB dust, so it is full. No held thesis is breaking on a stated level. Gold (4GLD.DE at 112.70) sits at the bottom of goldfinger's 112-120 box, and his break line is a close under 110, which has not printed. BTC-EUR at 59,236 is above satoshi's 56.3k break level, and both crypto analysts say hold the cores rather than exit. ALV.DE and AIR.PA sit inside a European defensive leadership that steady-eddie-eur and world both still endorse. NVDA (156.14 USD vs 219.21 avg) is the weak spot. The bearish Nasdaq note supports watching it, but no analyst has flipped NVDA to exit and I had set no stop on it. Loss harvesting belongs in December, not mid-November, so selling at a 29% loss now would be acting on price noise ahead of earnings. Levels I am watching for next session: 4GLD.DE close under 110, BTC-EUR close under 56.3k, QQQ under 647 confirming the Nasdaq breakdown (relevant to NVDA), and EUR cash staying above the floor. Default is HOLD, and no turnover is used this week.
